title: mentha tenorei
intro: Mentha tenorei, commonly known as Corsican mint, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha tenorei include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory, making it a valuable ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include menthone, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene, among others.
